name: input-otp
title: Input OTP
description: A segmented one-time-code input, built on input-otp.
docs:
Sound: the data-slot attributes on this component are read by the Sound layer, installed separately with `npx shadcn@latest add @kobra/sound`.
Keep the data-slot and data-sound attributes as written â they are the wiring, not decoration.
Wrap your app once in <SoundEffects> from components/ui/sound.tsx and every Kobra component answers a press.

.otp-processing.animation: otp-processing var(--otp-wave-duration) var(--otp-wave-ease) calc(var(--otp-wave-index) * var(--otp-wave-stagger)) infinite both

.otp-trail.animation: otp-trail var(--otp-trail-duration) var(--otp-trail-ease) calc(var(--otp-trail-index) * var(--otp-trail-stagger)) forwards

.otp-trail-success.animation: otp-trail-success var(--otp-success-duration) cubic-bezier(0.33, 0, 0.67, 1) calc(var(--otp-trail-index) * var(--otp-success-stagger)) forwards

.otp-bounce.animation: otp-bounce var(--otp-bounce-duration) linear calc(var(--otp-trail-index) * var(--otp-success-stagger)) forwards
